note: New experimental lane. Does NOT modify, extend, or supersede configs/benchmark_protocol_r8.json - R8/R10 remain the strong-baseline planner-to-planner comparison, unchanged. This is a separate operational comparator: a belief-aware learned policy (Grab the Crab GNN/RL) vs. a credible-but-deliberately-simpler deterministic reactive baseline (Dynamic Delimitation), both spending the same field-effort budget.

frozen_resource_contract.reason: 18 is simultaneously the max effort budget and the max number of decision windows possible only in the extreme case where every action is effort=1 (18 x e1 = 18 windows). 6 x e3 = 6 windows. 3 x e6 = 3 windows. Any mixed trajectory is valid provided sum(effort) <= 18 and num_windows <= 18. Do NOT raise the budget to 108 (18 windows x 6 effort) - the old max_rounds=6 horizon from benchmark_protocol_r8.json artificially prevented a small-effort policy from spending its full budget; this contract removes that artifact without changing the budget itself.

dynamic_delimitation_baseline.principle: confirmed first detection -> inspect local frontier -> survey at full effort -> positive expands frontier -> negative closes/deprioritizes that branch -> replan -> repeat
dynamic_delimitation_baseline.invariance_requirement: Dynamic planner output must be invariant to changes in belief/uncertainty/q/world weights when all allowed observable features stay unchanged.

gnn_horizon_change.note: SiteEffortRoundPolicy action space (site, effort in {1,3,6}) is unchanged; only the environment horizon changes. If the current best checkpoint was trained with max_rounds=6, it is NOT formally valid for R11 and must be retrained.
gnn_horizon_change.reward_contract: unchanged from configs/benchmark_protocol_r8.json frozen_rl_reward_contract for R11 v1 - no new effort/travel penalty added; effort/windows/travel are evaluation metrics only for this experiment, per the SSOT.
gnn_horizon_change.stop_action: OUT_OF_SCOPE_FOR_R11_V1 - no learned STOP token in R11 v1; may be introduced in a future R12.

training_seed_requirement.tuning_rule: No broad hyperparameter search. Do not modify simulator, reward, or Dynamic after seeing the formal R11 test set. Tune only on train/validation.

hidden_truth_gate: occupied_site_coverage and missed_occupied_fraction are computed evaluator-side only, after reveal. The policy/planner under test never receives hidden truth.

effort_to_parity.continuation_planner: Dynamic Delimitation only, unchanged rules, unchanged effort (always e6), unchanged information firewall
effort_to_parity.parity_not_reached_report: Did not reach parity within 2x the initial effort budget.
effort_to_parity.definition: E*_dyn = min{E >= 18 : C_dyn(E) >= C_gnn(18)}; ExtraEffort = E*_dyn - 18; EffortOverhead% = (E*_dyn - 18) / 18 * 100
effort_to_parity.parity_is_measured_on: unique confirmed-positive sites, NOT raw capture/detection event count

resource_cost_translation.preferred_headline_claim: X% more field effort required to reach the same confirmed extent
resource_cost_translation.travel_cost_gate: Do not convert effort overhead to fuel/$ until an explicit vessel/fuel model is frozen. Travel/access is an operational proxy (water_route.py), not a ground-truth cost.

determinism_requirement: Field potential outcomes must be deterministic with respect to (case_seed, site_id, visit_index, effort), not merely the current position of a global RNG stream, so that same incident + same action -> same field result regardless of which policy executed it or in what order.
claim_guardrail: On these frozen real-data-constrained synthetic incidents only. Never claim: beats experts, better than WDFW, optimal response, or proven real-world savings. This is plausibility evidence, not proof of operational superiority.

artifact_isolation.rule: This experiment must not modify configs/benchmark_protocol_r8.json, docs/R8_BENCHMARK_REPORT.md, or any R8 paired-comparison report.
